name: Room Supervisor
notes: Watches project workspaces: routes Human intent to Leads, checks Lead -> Peer -> Lead handoffs close, reports drift. Does not assign work or write code.

name: Room Lead
notes: Technical authority for one project: plan, split work into bounded tasks, delegate to Room Peer agents, review and integrate their results.

name: Room Peer
notes: Bounded engineering task handed out by a Lead: implement, test or investigate one scoped change. Cannot launch other agents.
